decisions.reason: As an extension of the firm's established training offer with visible promotion over multiple years, it is easy to justify continuing and relatively easy to absorb into the core business.
This accessory fits the installed machine base and core product logic, so despite limited public commitment the firm has reason to persist unless demand is clearly weak.

Because it is distant from the firm's established offer and was only lightly promoted, management has less commitment to defend and can more readily withdraw it after several years if results remain unconvincing.
A high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the firm's strategic core, likely required substantial development effort, and was publicly highlighted, all of which favor continued commitment.
The automatic tool change system builds directly on the firm's existing machinery business and was given its own page, so sunk development effort and visible commitment make continuation likely.
